subject: DVRL status: corrupted-sample numbers in, domain adaptation lagging
body:
Hi both,

Status ahead of the June 8 demo. Good news first: on the two tabular benchmarks, the corrupted-sample discovery run (main_corrupted_sample_discovery path) flags 87% of injected corrupted labels at 20% noise, comfortably above the 80% OKR line. Robust-learning accuracy holds within 0.6 points of the clean-data ceiling when we drop the bottom-valued 15% of examples.

The risk is domain adaptation. The main_domain_adaptation pipeline is sensitive to the source/target split, and value estimates get noisy when target data is scarce - we're seeing swings of 3-4 points between seeds. I need another two weeks of reward-shaping work before I'd show it to anyone external.

Proposal: demo data valuation + corrupted-sample discovery on the 8th, and mark domain adaptation "in validation". Rosa's harness makes the ablations easy to re-run, so no schedule risk there.

Wei
